capabilities: Convert PMID, PMCID, DOI, arXiv IDs or article URLs into metadata cards via paste, commands or context menu
Create one note per paper with metadata as properties, status, rating and tags
Generate a Bases overview of paper notes with table and shelf views
Add personal reading status, rating, tags and notes to cards
Refresh fetched paper metadata without overwriting user notes
extras: Sends identifiers to PubMed, Europe PMC, Crossref, arXiv and publisher pages only when converting; no telemetry and no clipboard access. Warns that some publishers (e.g. Elsevier) block automated page requests, and that Auto Card Link's paste enhancement can conflict with paste-to-card.
intentEvidence: Think Auto Card Link, but for papers: instead of a generic web preview, metadata comes from scholarly databases.
problem: Pasting a paper link into Obsidian yields a generic web preview without scholarly fields like authors, journal, abstract, MeSH terms and identifiers.

relations.evidence: Think Auto Card Link, but for papers: instead of a generic web preview
NCBI E-utilities / PubMed — article metadata by PMID
Europe PMC REST API — metadata by DOI / PMCID / PMID
Crossref REST API — metadata for DOIs not indexed in Europe PMC

summary: Converts a PMID, PMCID, DOI, arXiv ID or article URL into a rich metadata card and per-paper notes with reading status.
